verdict.rationale: Kit's V4 API documents campaign (broadcast) metrics well. Endpoints return per-broadcast delivery and engagement stats, per-link click performance, batch stats for a page of broadcasts, and account-level email stats, with 5 years of email-stat retention. The evidence does not show any endpoint for flow-level (sequence or automation) performance, which is half of the story. missing for 10: flow/sequence/automation performance metrics endpoints, warehouse-export or bulk historical export documentation, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can pull campaign and flow performance metrics through the API into my own warehouse or dashboards

citations.quote: Returns delivery and engagement stats for a single broadcast: recipients, opens, clicks, unsubscribes, their corresponding rates, plus the sending `status` and `progress`.
Returns click performance for each link in a broadcast: the link `url`, its `unique_clicks`, and its click-to-delivery and click-to-open rates.
for a page of broadcasts in a single request, avoiding a call per broadcast.
Returns account-level email performance for the last 90 days: `sent`, `opened`, and `clicked` counts plus open, click, unsubscribe, and bounce rates
The API returns email stats for the **last 5 years (60 months)**
